title: Telecom Egypt and Huawei launch new FTTR broadband service for faster home internet.
snippet: Telecom Egypt, operating under the WE brand, has partnered with Huawei to launch a new Fiber-to-the-Room (FTTR) broadband service in Egypt, introducing a next-generation home internet solution designed to improve speed, stability, and wireless coverage across homes.

title_and_summary: Telecom Egypt wins Top Employer award for 2026
